admission: Require at least three additional useful lower-SNR locations across three distinct held readers without a matched ordinary collision, at most two added ordinary files across at most two readers at the lower level, no new isolated-room flag, no greater loss than one cleanly located higher-SNR result, and no more than two added misplaced edited ranges at either level. Otherwise keep outside serving. This evaluates localization under known controlled backgrounds and provides no standalone AI-origin confidence calibration.
candidate: Apply the same frozen focused speech head to original PCM and a same-clock enhanced reading. Use pinned GTCRN first channel output. Consider widths 0.30, 0.45, 0.65, 0.85 and 1.05 seconds every 0.05 seconds. Require at least half of the interval and the 0.30-second flanks to be speech-admitted using the original VAD with 0.05-second gaps. For each view, compute mean content score inside minus the greater mean of both flanks, plus 0.25 times the smaller of the two mean boundary scores within two 10 ms frames either side of each boundary. The proposal uses the lower score of the two views for that same interval.
cases: Each unseen reader supplies one six-second matched cut-and-paste/original source pair. At each level, test the exact same mixture bed across the original, labeled AI edit, and an ordinary same-recording cross-faded splice using the same known interval. Also test isolated room audio. Use annotation only to render the controls and evaluate errors.
comparison: Retain the current standalone two-second scan. Separately measure raw focused contrast, enhanced focused contrast, the shared-interval candidate, and using the shared-interval candidate only on current non-flags. The two-second point stays frozen. Set each research point at the 95th percentile of genuine reader maxima over both levels and both ordinary roles, bounded below by the strongest calibration room only. Keep points independent of the held outcomes.
enhancement_clock: Enhance the 0–4 and 2–6 second windows separately with canonical GTCRN length binding, then blend over their shared 2–4 second region with a fixed squared-sine ramp. Preserve the exact 96000-sample clock. The retained helper bounds a single enhancement to four seconds. This adjustment was frozen before reading any score.
matching: Cover at least 50% of the labeled edited samples and 30% of the temporal union. Count a matched original or genuine splice on the same edit clock as a collision. Treat both levels as paired repeated cases.
rooms: Use the eight exact retained AMI room excerpts. Calibration uses the first four and held uses the last four, in the earlier public receipt order. Use each room at nominal minus 5 and plus 3 dB foreground-to-room ratio. Shards and room excerpts are reused. Enrollment disjointness refers to the previously selected reader IDs and the foreground PCM SHA values. Model pretraining and corpus identity overlap are unknown.
source_roles: Choose up to 28 unused SINE readers before inference from retained official 192 MiB prefixes 7 through 29 in ascending shard order. Exclude all reader IDs named in the earlier SINE preview, main, narrow, background, short-window duration, union and input-views receipts. Use the stable prior reader hash ranking to choose 12 calibration readers and the next 16 held readers. Use no reader in both roles. Replace a missing room wave only before scoring, by an equally pinned record.
